$comment: SealLink v1.0 Authoritative Refusal Code Registry. No normative document may emit a refusal code absent from this file. Verifiers report the FIRST failing code in each pipeline's deterministic check order.

codes.description: Document exceeds type max_bytes or nesting depth > 16.
Invalid UTF-8, BOM present, trailing bytes, or malformed RFC 8259 JSON object.
Duplicate object member name (after escape resolution) or Unicode fold alias in name value.
Forbidden JSON value (e.g., null).
JSON number has sign, fraction, exponent, leading zero, or exceeds 2^53 - 1.
Number-form or string-form integer violates grammar or schema bound.
String contains forbidden control character (< U+0020 except U+000A in multiline prose fields, U+007F DEL, C1 U+0080..U+009F) or unpaired surrogate.
Re-encoded Restricted RFC 8785 JCS bytes differ from input octets.
Unregistered, unsupported, or unexpected object type string.
Missing required member, unknown member, or member type/form mismatch.
Malformed public key encoding or invalid curve point.
Malformed signature encoding, failed cryptographic verification, policy mismatch, or SignatureSet threshold unmet.
Malformed or unsupported Constraint Algebra predicate or populated reserved extension.
Node network or genesis hash does not match verifier's pinned chain.
Reading node is in IBD, unreachable, missing txindex, or lags header tip beyond LAG.
A healthy independent comparison node disagrees on chain tip or sits ahead of reading node.
Verifier clock regressed below durable monotonic mark or block header exceeds future bound S.
Tip age max(now - header_time, now - first_sight) exceeds action risk-class cutoff.
Chain tip changed between start and end reads of a single observation.
Output script does not match any supported ScriptPolicy template or compiled scriptPubKey.
Transaction violates Witness construction profile (non-SegWit input, non-SIGHASH_ALL, unconfirmed funding, bad linkage).
Missing, duplicate, reserved, or malformed SLNK OP_RETURN commitment frame or invalid Merkle inclusion proof.
Required transaction confirmation depth is below max(signed_min_depth, operator_floor).
Recent block hash R is off active chain or anchor height falls outside (R, R + K].
Seal UTXO is unconfirmed, has mismatched script, single-use seal not yet spent by grantee, or chain read is inconclusive; never treated as unspent or closed.
Validated revocation spend of a live seal UTXO (mempool or block); recorded as permanent closure.
Name does not exist or has no confirmed output on active chain.
Name output has reached or passed expiry height (h + D).
Name UTXO ScriptPolicy does not match pinned owner policy or transferred away.
Current name value was not authored by pinned ScriptPolicy with SIGHASH_ALL on all required signatures.
Name transaction history walk exceeded operator step bound or node could not supply history.
Name value exceeds 520 bytes or violates strict link / m member grammar.
Owner-signed change or removal of the bound role key or role-policy pin in name history (durable closure for active grants).
Manifest or pinned off-chain set bytes are missing from presentation and configured stores.
Manifest or set bytes fail SHA-256 pin, name, network, or seq equality.
Manifest or set seq decreased (or hash changed at equal seq) while journaled anchoring_txid remains on active chain.
Auth challenge TTL > 120s or now >= expires_at.
Wrong audience, reused/unknown nonce, provisional policy failure, or upgrade binding mismatch.
Manifest lacks paired auth_key/auth_seal or key mismatch.
Device key not in pinned device list, level ceiling insufficient, or presented to a foreign verifier.
Origin certificate missing, untrusted issuer policy, class mismatch, mismatched majority_commitment opening, or invalid anchor.
Single-use name binding seal missing, out of height order, or registration already bound.

Origin status_seal, roster_seal, or confirmed 0x0c recovery_seal was spent on chain (or spine walk reached depth limit / majority_commitment opening withheld) without presenting the matching committed record.
Subject has ward status; autonomous signature without satisfying guardian quorum is forbidden.

Guardianship slot is vacant, pending delay, vetoed, contested/burned, halted, expired, or closed. (When triggered by a witnessed spend of an active slot seal, the slot seal spend itself records a durable guardian_slot closure.)
Valid distinct guardian slot signatures do not meet verifier-derived event_class threshold against approved revision_size.

Guardianship ended (calendar majority T cutoff or confirmed capacity/1); admission paused for both sides until confirmed capacity/1 subject_new_owner_policy handover transfer and subject self-update (or 0x0c recovery).
Credible wall-clock interval straddles majority boundary T or cannot be established; admission paused.
Verified seallink-end/1 record permanently terminates all admission for this subject.
Origin sets name_recovery=none, recovery delay incomplete, or cancelled by live OwnerPolicy (0x10).
Grant or action profile requires a bound contract (and framework if named) that was not presented.
Recomputed salted contract_id (or framework_id) does not match bound reference.
Missing, expired, replayed, or invalid party seallink-assent/1.
Required contract or framework seal is absent, unconfirmed, or has mismatched ScriptPolicy.
Grant window, executor, party binding, or machine capabilities violate bound contract, framework nesting, or undisclosed machine_clause_indices.
Agreed configuration manifest hash does not match runtime configuration.
Signed-form credential or notary anchor (0x09 / 0x04) missing or below required depth.
Credential anchor height >= owner-authenticated compromise height h_c (0x0b).
Current chain height or UTC time outside credential validity window.
Revocable credential or notary seal spent with verified cause commitment (0x0a / 0x05).
Missing or invalid notary act where required by parent policy or verifier policy.
Grant or ancestor link is permanently closed in durable closure journal.
Validated tip height outside half-open [not_before_height, not_after_height) window or grant exceeds issuer name expiry at issuance.
Grant uses revocation=window_only, but executor policy requires a confirmed UTXO seal.
Grant executor (or resolved executor_ref) does not match this service's pinned identity.
Dynamic executor_ref used with an external-mutation or profile-disallowed action (structurally invalid executor_ref + quotas/single_use/delegate refuses WIRE_MEMBER at schema validation).
Root grant issuer (or executor_ref.provider_of) is not authorized by the owning action profile to grant authority over the target resource.
Action profile requires a bilateral contract (requires_contract=true), but grant is unilateral.
Mechanical effect executor refused a grant carrying operative free-text terms.
Child grant presented under a parent without delegation rights or exceeding depth 2 (structurally invalid child + delegate or window_only + delegate refuses WIRE_MEMBER at schema validation).
Child grant fails mechanical Constraint Algebra narrowing, recipient_rule, child_seal_key, row cap, whole-parent pool aggregate (R8.5), window, or template check against parent.
Child ordinal out of range, row coin not spent by individual 0x01 anchor, overlapping row/stop ranges (R8.6), or stop coin invalid/aliased.
Notary spent the row stop coin; row permanently closed for cause.
Requested action is unregistered, unsupported by executor, or absent from grant capabilities.
Recognized optional-declaration v1.0 module operation or object type is disabled by this implementation's conformance profile (CONFORMANCE.md §1.1; zero journal writes).
Signed invocation target or arguments violate a grant capability where-predicate or profile check.
Wall-clock now outside invocation half-open [iat, exp) window.
Duplicate nonce, terminal invocation missing stored receipt blob, or already-consumed single-use grant.
Request lacks a mandatory profile quota or exceeds own grant quota, parent row cap, session cap, or operator ceiling.
Clock regressed below durable period watermark for a seconds-based quota.
Unknown, expired, closed, or slot-mismatched bearer session token.
Local journal or external CAS witness unreadable, mismatched, or behind witness (rollback detected).
Writer no longer holds the active external witness fencing token.
Resource owner's manifest does not bind this service's pinned NamePin as provider for the claimed label/type.
Export/import handover incomplete, unclosed predecessor grant, credentials leaked in export, or rollback.
Peer failed trust policy, screening cap, human disclosure gate, or Contour A PII routing invariant.
